settings.title: Company assets settings
settings.noticeDaysNote: Default notice for the deadlines the module records in the shared deadline schedule.
settings.notificationsNote: When off, the module sends no notifications or reminders. Each user chooses how to receive them from the notification preferences.

vehicleList.title: Company vehicles
vehicleList.confirmDelete: Delete vehicle {{targa}} with its assignments, deadlines, costs and fines?

vehicleEdit.title: Vehicle
vehicleEdit.contractNote: The expiry of the rental or leasing contract goes into the shared deadline schedule.
vehicleEdit.fringeNote: The fringe benefit is 15,000 conventional km times the ACI cost per km, with the assignment's percentage (from emissions: up to 60 g/km 25%, up to 160 30%, up to 190 50%, above 60%). The payroll export stays in Attendance.
vehicleEdit.assignmentNote: Each assignment creates or updates the employee's car used by Attendance expense reports for mileage reimbursements.

vehicleItem.fringeNote: Leave 0 to use the percentage from the vehicle's emissions ({{co2}} g/km).
vehicleItem.carNote: The employee's car with this reimbursement is used by Attendance expense reports.
vehicleItem.deadlineNote: The deadline goes into the shared deadline schedule; entering the date it was done closes it.
vehicleItem.driverAuto: From the assignment on the offence date
vehicleItem.fineNote: Without a driver, whoever had the vehicle on the offence date is proposed. The notice to the driver is sent from the list of fines.

mine.title: My resources
mine.fringeNote: Fringe benefit for the current year, for information only: payroll computes the value on the payslip.
mine.goodsNote: Reports to confirm open in the acknowledgements page.

goodsList.title: Company items
goodsList.noReturns: No items or vehicles to return
goodsList.returnNote: Items and vehicles still held by employees with a termination date. Every night the administrators are notified of new terminations within the notice period and the return goes into the deadline schedule; Check now runs it immediately.
goodsList.confirmDelete: Delete item {{nome}} with its delivery history?

goodEdit.title: Item
goodEdit.deliveriesNote: On delivery and return the employee receives the report to confirm (with Document management active, to sign).
goodEdit.warrantyNote: The warranty expiry goes into the shared deadline schedule.
goodEdit.confirmDeleteAssignment: Cancel this delivery? Reports not yet confirmed are withdrawn.

goodItem.deliveryNote: The employee receives the delivery report to confirm in the acknowledgements (with Document management active, to sign). Without a user only the delivery is recorded.
goodItem.returnNote: The employee receives the return report; any deadline for the return on termination is closed.
